children.text: Nexora deploys talent, AI and robotics for enterprises across Southeast Asia and beyond. We designed and built the site that introduces all of it — humanoid deployment, sidewalk delivery and warehouse automation — in one place.
The brief was to make an emerging robotics company feel proven and ready to deploy. Live figures, named partners and full-bleed video carry that weight, so the writing never has to oversell.
